text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, during training...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I've noticed that your recent training
sessions
have centered on improving
your trainee's
breathing mid-race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You've also taken to slope training,
which builds
stamina and emphasizes
endurance over speed...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Are you perhaps planning on running a

long-distance race?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You got me there. Nothing's
been
announced publicly yet, so could
you keep that
off the record?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'm here to ask about your
trainee's
progress, nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer
<username>.
 It's
nice to see you again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Otonashi is here to conduct

interviews for her magazine, but I'm
noticing
something...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Well, I am a reporter. It's my job to have a certain amount of background knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The more knowledgeable I am on the
subject
matter, the better the articles I
can write.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Miss Otonashi takes the subject
of
Umamusume more seriously than I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I do apologize. I've only been
talking about
myself.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as we've got the chance, would
you mind
if I asked you about your
trainee?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What would you say is your next hurdle?
It
doesn't have to be anything big.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For all that she insists she's just a
reporter, her
expertise might come in
handy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Strength, you say?! That's... simply
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Slope and weight training are both
effective ways
of building strength.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But the most important thing by far is
diet! Strong
and supple muscles are
made in the kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So you must be hunting for the very best

ingredients! I'm talking long-lived
Okinawan pork,
clifftop swallow's nests,
and deep-sea fish from
the ocean floor...
Ah, such devotion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(I think she might have gotten the wrong
idea
there, but her comments about diet
are very
useful.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deep-sea fish might be a little out of my
budget,
but I later catch a white fish
that's good for
building muscle and
serve it to
<chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Speed, you say?! That's...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Simply amazing!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for speed, it's important
to
manage your body fat percentage
and reduce
your weight without losing
muscle...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, that can be really tough, and
some
Umamusume even get sick from
the stress.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That's why you have to make an effort to
prevent
your trainee from getting
stressed out!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So you must be sparing no expense! I'm
talking
renting out amusement parks,
luxury cruises, and
cross-continental
overseas road trips... Ah, such
devotion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(I think she might have gotten the wrong
idea
there, but her comments about
reducing body fat
percentage are very
useful.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cruises and overseas travel might be a
little out
of my budget, but I make sure
to give
<chrname> a chance
to relax as a
reward for getting through
our grueling training.
